title: AnalyticsEvent
responsibility: Stores timestamped analytics event payloads in events through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.id
inputs.description: Stored row identity; the model passes it to the adapter without generating a key.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.timestamp
inputs.description: Timestamp attached to the stored analytics event.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.data
inputs.description: Structured payload retained by the adapter; no model code is executed to describe it.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.find
outputs.description: Promise of the matching events row, or null according to the adapter lookup result.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.findBy
outputs.description: Promise of events rows matching the supplied attribute filters.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.create
outputs.description: Promise of the events row returned by the adapter after creation.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.update
outputs.description: Promise of the updated events row, or null according to the adapter update result.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.delete
outputs.description: Promise of the adapter deletion result for the requested events row.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Adapter exceptions and promise rejections pass through unchanged; caller-provided field getters can also throw during argument copying.
